responsibility: Defines ISO text I/O on the default channels for characters and strings. It declares standard-input operations for character, line-rest, line-bounded string, token, and line-skipping reads, and standard-output procedures for character, line mark, and string writes, using the shared read-result conventions of the gm2 channel subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the specification half of the STextIO pair: it defines the public default-channel text I/O API for clients, while STextIO.mod provides the actual forwarding bodies to TextIO and StdChans.
